name: f1f2
description: F1 system recall and F2 false-mark behaviour for one project memory: a deployment default port plus a stable rollback-script fact. Labels are the ground truth and were fixed before any run. The agent is restricted to the extension's memory tools, so every turn is answerable from memory alone; the seeded workspace exists only to make the scenario coherent. No turn text names memories, marking, updating or staleness: every mark is the agent's or the detector's own judgement, never an instruction the turn gave it.

memory.title: 部署默认端口
context: 这套服务用 deploy.sh 发布到测试和生产两套环境，两边共用同一个默认端口，改端口时要同时确认反向代理、健康检查、监控探针和容器端口映射指向的端口，发布之后还要实际请求一次首页和一条业务接口，确认新端口真的在接收流量，避免其中一处漏改导致请求打不进来却没人发现，同时通知值班同学确认监控面板没有异常报警，确认无误后再关闭旧的发布任务。
并发上限决定单个实例同时处理的请求数，调低会减少内存占用但也会拉长排队时间，调高则可能压垮数据库连接池，所以调整之前应该先在测试环境观察一段时间的错误率、响应时间和连接数，确认没有明显退化再同步到生产，并在发布记录里写明调整前后的数值和观察结果，方便事后回溯，也方便交接。
回滚流程以 ops/rollback.sh 为准，脚本会把当前版本撤回到上一个发布版本，每次改动端口或并发参数之后都要在测试环境演练一次回滚，确认脚本、镜像标签和发布记录仍然对得上，再把结果补进运维手册，让下一个人遇到问题时能照着文档操作，避免遗漏关键步骤。

workspace.deploy.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# 项目部署脚本：默认端口与并发上限都从这里读取。
# 回滚见 ops/rollback.sh。
set -euo pipefail

PORT=3456
WORKERS=8
LOG_ROTATION=hourly

echo "deploy on port ${PORT} with ${WORKERS} workers"
workspace.ops/rollback.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# 回滚脚本：把部署撤销回上一个版本。
set -euo pipefail

echo "rolling back to the previous release"
workspace.README.md:
# demo 服务

部署用 `deploy.sh`，默认端口写在脚本里。回滚脚本位于 `ops/rollback.sh`。

turns.text: 项目现在部署用的默认端口是多少？
turns.label: READ
turns.note: Surfaces the memory so the session has it and the detector may inspect it. No marking expected; the workspace on disk already matches the stored fact, so any event here is a false mark.

turns.text: 默认端口已经从 3456 改成 5678 了。
turns.label: CHANGE
turns.note: The stored default port (3456) changed to 5678. A plain statement of the change: it does not name memories, marking, updating or staleness, so a mark here is proactive detection, not instruction-following. Exactly one new event expected; the agent cannot rewrite the memory, so the summary stays at 5678 only after retrieval-side repair.

turns.label: CONFIRM
turns.note: Restates the current value. No event.

turns.text: 如果以后要换成 7777，需要注意什么？
turns.label: HYPOTHESIS
turns.note: Conditional or future wording. No event.

turns.text: 我本来想把端口改成 4321，后来没有动，还是 5678。
turns.label: FAILED
turns.note: The change was attempted and did not take effect. No event.

turns.text: 日志轮转策略改成每天一次了。
turns.label: UNRELATED
turns.note: A different part of the project changed, stated without referring to the memory page. No event for this memory.

turns.text: 默认端口改成 6789 了，同时把并发上限降到 4。
turns.label: MULTI
turns.note: Two distinct changes in one turn. The seeded memory carries both facts (默认端口 3456, 并发上限 8), so both are genuine changes to this memory and both need their own event: the default port becomes 6789 and the worker cap drops to 4. Two events.
